summary.note: Predictions are from the weather-only RF+LR ensemble trained on 2025–2026 field data, applied to 2021–2025 NASA POWER climate for Ranchi and averaged by day-of-year. Disease incidence is also subject to rearing season and management practices.
summary.disclaimer: Disease incidence is subject to rearing season, crop stage, and management practices. This calendar indicates climate-based risk only and should be used as a decision-support tool, not a definitive forecast.
